title: Recursive Asynchronous Crawler & Chunked SHA-256 Deduplicator
description: Implement 'backend/catalog/scanner/crawler.py'. Create class 'RepositoryCrawler' that recursively walks a target root directory scanning for '.exe', '.msi', and '.msp' files. For each discovered binary: (1) Extract the relative parent folder chain as context breadcrumbs (ignoring drive letters and root path); (2) Compute the SHA-256 hash using 1MB chunked memory-efficient buffered reads; (3) Query 'binary_assets' in SQLite to detect if the hash already exists; (4) Register the physical path in 'file_locations' and mark 'is_primary_copy=1' for the first occurrence (or shortest path) and '0' for redundant duplicates. Provide method 'scan_directory(root_path: str, db_session) -> dict'.
verification_command: python -c "from backend.catalog.scanner.crawler import RepositoryCrawler; c = RepositoryCrawler(); print('CAT-004 passed')"

title: Target Path Resolver & Sanitary Folder Tree Synthesizer
description: Implement 'backend/catalog/organizer/path_resolver.py'. Create class 'TargetPathResolver' that transforms enriched 'BinaryAsset' + 'SoftwareProduct' records into clean target paths following the template: '{category_prefix}_{category_name}/{subcategory_name}/{canonical_vendor}/{canonical_name}/{version}/{clean_filename}'. Rules: (1) Sanitize all path segments (replace spaces with underscores or keep clean alphanumeric, strip illegal OS characters); (2) If 'confidence_score < 0.70', route to '99_Unclassified_Orphan_Binaries/{parent_folder_chain}/{current_filename}' with action 'SKIP_LOW_CONFIDENCE'; (3) If 'is_primary_copy == 0', set action to 'DELETE_DUPLICATE' (or 'ARCHIVE_DUPLICATE'); (4) Handle filename collisions by appending short hash suffixes if two distinct binaries map to the exact same target path. Provide 'generate_migration_plans(db_session) -> List[MigrationProposalContract]'.
verification_command: python -c "from backend.catalog.organizer.path_resolver import TargetPathResolver; r = TargetPathResolver(); print('CAT-009 passed')"
test_command: python -c "from backend.catalog.organizer.path_resolver import TargetPathResolver; r = TargetPathResolver(); print('CAT-009 passed')"

title: Transactional Migration Executor & Rollback Journal
description: Implement 'backend/catalog/organizer/executor.py'. Create class 'StorageMigrationExecutor' that executes approved 'migration_plans' safely: (1) 'dry_run(target_root: str, db_session) -> dict' computes total bytes to move, space reclaimed by deduplication, folder tree diff preview, and checks disk write permissions; (2) 'execute_plan(target_root: str, db_session, mode="COPY_OR_MOVE") -> dict' performs file operations, verifies SHA-256 integrity at destination before removing source, updates 'migration_plans.status = EXECUTED', and writes an append-only 'migration_rollback_manifest.json' containing (location_id, source_path, dest_path, sha256, timestamp); (3) 'rollback_migration(manifest_path: str, db_session) -> dict' restores files to their exact original locations and cleans up empty created directories.

Provide method 'run_full_pipeline(source_root: str, target_root: str, db_session) -> dict'. STRICT: Never import from non-existent 'backend.catalog.indexing' or 'backend.catalog.resolver'.

title: End-to-End Synthetic Messy Repository Golden Test Suite
description: Implement 'tests/catalog/test_golden_catalog.py' to validate the entire pipeline unattended. STRICT FIX: Define module-level `@pytest.fixture` functions for `source_root`, `target_root`, and `db_session` at the top of the file using `tmp_path` so they are globally available as pytest fixtures. Do NOT nest fixtures inside test classes or use autouse fixtures that require missing parameters. The test suite dynamically generates a temporary chaotic folder tree containing: (1) Mock '.exe' files with synthetic PE VS_VERSION_INFO headers; (2) A byte-for-byte duplicate '.exe' in a deeply nested subfolder; (3) A mock '.msi' installer. Assert that: 'SoftwareCatalogOrchestrator' deduplicates the identical binary, extracts PE/MSI strings, assigns high-confidence software to proper taxonomy folders, routes low-confidence binaries to '99_Unclassified_Orphan_Binaries', executes file reorganization into a clean target root, and cleanly restores the original messy tree upon rollback.
